summary: Two degree tracks run in parallel and deliberately feed different halves of the same goal: the technical programs build the ability to make intelligent systems, and the international business studies build the judgment about contracts, markets, and rules that decide how those systems should be used.

entries.notes: Stated on the public GitHub profile; AUPP operates an accredited dual-degree partnership with Fort Hays State University. The 20 October 2025 start date is owner-confirmed.
Completed through the AUPP–FHSU dual-degree partnership, so it runs on the same 20 October 2025 start.

entries.institution: Institute of Foreign Languages (IFL), Royal University of Phnom Penh
entries.notes: IFL's Department of English runs the B.A. in English for Work Skills over four years: Years I–III are shared coursework, and students take a Year-IV major in English for International Business, Translation and Interpreting, or English for Professional Communication. Enrolment began 1 January 2026, so International Business is the declared direction rather than a finished specialisation. This is the coursework behind the Governance & Commercial Rules pillar — contracts, terms, policies, and commercial rules.
